gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-parkinsans: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills its lowercase with big bodies, while Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout. The heading is best at shouting a few chunky words; the sans-serif body is best at staying crisp and wide-mouthed once the type gets small.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-pathway-ext: Pathway Extreme reads modern and clean, with rounded letters that stay open and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And Capture Smallz, raw and tactical with its big-bodied lowercase, gives that tidy sans something rougher to lean against.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-preahvihear: Capture Smallz hits with raw, tactical lowercase letters that carry big bodies. But Preahvihear, a sans-serif with a lofty x-height and mouths pried open like oyster shells, would keep a long passage feeling light and easy to move through.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-prompt: Prompt reads approachable and neutral, its small letters looking oversized and its apertures open enough to take in at a glance. Capture Smallz does its best work as the raw, tactical voice up top, whereas Prompt is the plain sans that carries everything after it.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-pt-sans-cap: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz its raw, tactical stance, though it would lose that muscle if the heading were made small. PT Sans Caption, a sans-serif with unclosed, inviting bowls, is the one that copes happily when the text is large.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-puritan: Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical lowercase with big bodies, and Puritan is its opposite in temperament. But the heading is best at making a blunt first impression, while the sans body, with rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, is best at feeling approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-questrial: Questrial reads modern and professional, a flat, stencil-cut sans with single-weight strokes and a tall band of letters under short stalks. And Capture Smallz, raw and big-bodied, would give a long passage in that voice a rougher edge to push against.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-radio-canad: Contemporary lines meet raw ones here: Capture Smallz is tactical and big-bodied, with curves as heavy as stems, like cord. Radio Canada is the sans-serif that does its best work with a steady line and a clear opening at the end of every curve.

Neutral and contemporary, Radio Canada Big stays monoline throughout. Capture Smallz is best at being raw and tactical with big-bodied lowercase, while the plain sans body is best at finishing terminals clear of the stem and filling the line.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads professional and neutral, with broad gaps at the terminals and a calm weight that never shifts along a curve. Capture Smallz earns its keep when it is big and short, raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase letters.
